author: Stan Horwitz
text: You need two iPhone apps. The first one is the LebreLinkUp app, which connects the Libre 3 app with Apple’s Health app. This app is a freebie. You also need an app called Shuggah which sends the Libre data from the Health app to your Apple Watch every 15 minutes. The Shugga app has a small monthly fee.
